definitions.full: H5581. Sismay ִססְמַי proper name, masculine name in Judah (on Phoenician proper name, of divinity. ססמ(יׅ see Lzb 330 Ren in CIS i. No. 95, 3, al Bae Rel 64 f. Kit 1Chr 2:40 ); — ׳ס 2:40 b, ִססְמָ֑י 2:40 a; ᵐ5 Σοσομαι , ᵐ5 L Σασαμει .
